name: Morphing Julia Set
recipe: An animated Julia set: the complex parameter c orbits a slow loop in the plane on K.t so the fractal continuously morphs between dendrite, rabbit, dragon and spiral forms — a living escape-time fractal. Default COLORFUL: smooth-iteration count through an iq palette (electric blue/violet interior glow -> gold filaments), interior tinted (not black). Luminance ~0.2-0.5, fills frame.
kernel: per-pixel buffer (<=200 wide): z=pixel, iterate z=z^2+c ~60-120 times, smooth escape = n + 1 - log(log|z|)/log2, map through palette LUT; interior (non-escaped) gets a dark-tinted glow, not pure black. c orbits on K.t (e.g. 0.7885*e^{i*theta(t)}); pan/zoom drift for extra life. Cache nothing (recompute).
style: electric (default, blue/violet interior -> gold filaments). Also: ember (blackbody), psychedelic (full-spectrum bands), ice (cyan/white), etched (named mono, white on black).

name: Magnetic Pendulum Basins
recipe: The magnetic-pendulum fractal: for each pixel (a release point) simulate a pendulum pulled by 3-4 magnets + friction and colour by WHICH magnet it finally settles on — producing infinitely-detailed fractal basin boundaries with delicate filigree between smooth attractor pools. Slowly rotate the magnet ring + drift friction on K.t so the basins churn and re-form. Default COLORFUL: 3-4 vivid basin hues (magenta/cyan/gold/lime) with dark boundary filigree, luminance ~0.25-0.5, fills frame.
kernel: per-pixel buffer (<=160 wide): integrate the pendulum ODE ~120-200 steps from the pixel's start position (magnet pulls 1/r^2-ish + friction + restoring), record nearest magnet at rest, colour by magnet index shaded by settle-time. Magnets rotate on K.t (rebuild is intrinsic per frame — keep <=160 wide for perf).
style: basins (default, 4 vivid hues + dark filigree). Also: thermal (settle-time blackbody), pastel (soft), neon-edge (boundaries only glowing), ink (named mono, 4 greys).

name: Suminagashi Marbling
recipe: Japanese suminagashi paper-marbling: concentric ink rings dropped onto water are raked and stirred into hypnotic swirled veins, combed waves and paisley — the classic marbled-paper look. The rake/stir field evolves on K.t so the marble perpetually flows and re-combs. Default COLORFUL: alternating ink hues (indigo/crimson/gold rings) on pale water, OR black/indigo on cream. Luminance ~0.3-0.55, fills frame.
kernel: maintain many concentric ring point-sets (or a coarse dye field) in S; apply marbling operators — radial drops + a time-varying curl/comb displacement field (K.t) that shears the rings into veins; render rings as smooth stroked bands or advect a dye buffer. Keep the swirl continuous.
style: suminagashi (default, indigo/crimson/gold rings on pale). Also: nonpareil (fine combed multi-color), stone-marble (grey/gold veins), oil-float (iridescent), sumi (named mono, black on cream).

name: Forest-Fire CA
recipe: The forest-fire cellular automaton: green trees grow, lightning ignites fires that spread as glowing fronts through connected forest and burn out to ash, then trees regrow — self-organized-critical waves of fire sweeping the frame forever. EMERGENT SOC. Default COLORFUL: green trees, hot orange/yellow fire fronts, dark ash, on soil; luminance ~0.2-0.5, edge-to-edge.
kernel: coarse grid state {empty,tree,burning} in S (<=200 wide); each frame: tree->burning if a neighbor burns or rare lightning; burning->empty; empty->tree with small prob; render via LUT (green/fire-gradient/ash) into pixels[] buffer, upscale. K.t gates step rate; sweeping fire fronts are the motion.
style: wildfire (default, green/orange/ash). Also: ember-night (dark, glowing fronts), autumn (amber forest), toxic (blue-green fire), heatmap (named mono-ish, burn-age).

name: Magnetic Field Lines
recipe: Iron filings tracing the field of drifting magnetic dipoles: streamlines follow the superposed dipole field into the classic looping bipolar arcs and cusps, filings clustering densely at the poles. The dipoles orbit/rotate on K.t so the field lines writhe and reconnect. Default COLORFUL: filings tinted by field strength (cool weak -> hot dense at poles) on dark, or classic iron-grey on white. Luminance ~0.2-0.5, fills frame.
kernel: place 2-4 drifting dipoles (position+orientation on K.t) in S; seed many streamline starts, integrate along the analytic dipole field for K steps drawing short filing-segments (density/brightness by |B|); clustering at poles emerges. Redraw each frame (short segments), continuous dipole motion.
style: field-heat (default, |B| cool->hot on dark). Also: iron-grey (classic filings on white), aurora (green/violet lines), neon-flux (glowing on black), blueprint (named mono, white lines on blue).

name: Glyph Rain
recipe: Falling columns of luminous glyphs (Matrix digital rain): streams of code-symbols cascade down at varying speeds, bright leading head fading to dim tails, glyphs flickering/mutating as they fall. Dense enough to fill the frame; occasional brighter surges. Default COLORFUL: phosphor green (classic) with a white-hot head — but offer amber, cyan, spectral. Luminance ~0.15-0.4 (bright glyphs on near-black), fills frame.
kernel: column array in S (per-column head position, speed, glyph seeds); each frame advance heads (K.t-gated), draw glyphs as small rects/segment-font marks with brightness by distance-behind-head (fade tail), mutate a few glyphs; recycle columns off-bottom. No text() needed — use a 5x7 segment/box glyph or small rects.
style: phosphor (default, green + white head). Also: amber-crt, cyan-ice, spectral (rainbow columns), bone (named mono, white on black).

name: Hyperspace Starfield
recipe: A parallax starfield accelerating into hyperspace: stars stream outward from a vanishing point as elongating light-streaks, faster/longer toward the edges, with a subtle central glow and occasional color-shifted stars — the warp-jump look. Warp speed pulses on K.t/section. Default COLORFUL: cool white/blue stars with a few warm ones + faint nebula tint; luminance ~0.12-0.35 (streaks on near-black), fills frame.
kernel: star array in S (3D-ish: x,y,z); each frame decrease z (approach), project to screen from a drifting vanishing point, draw as a streak from previous to current projected pos (length grows as z->0), recycle past-camera stars; warp factor on K.t. Additive streaks + faint central glow.
style: hyperspace (default, blue-white streaks). Also: warp-rainbow (spectral trails), ember-drive (warm), ghost (pale), vector (named mono, white streaks).

name: Feedback Tunnel
recipe: FIX of a version that COLLAPSED to a tiny cyan blob in a black frame (no tunnel, near-static motion 0.009). Re-author so the video-feedback ACTUALLY BUILDS A TUNNEL that FILLS THE FRAME: each frame copy the whole previous buffer back scaled slightly >1 (e.g. 1.03) and rotated a few degrees so content spirals OUTWARD to the edges (or <1 to spiral inward) — the recursion must propagate across the entire frame, not sit in the center. Inject a BOLD recurring motif every frame (a large ring / polygon / bar whose hue rotates on K.t) so there is always fresh content feeding the echo. Keep it bright (luminance ~0.25-0.5) and never wash to white (tune the per-frame fade). Continuous zoom+rotate = strong motion.
kernel: persistent full-frame buffer in S; each frame: draw buffer into itself with push/translate(center)/scale(1.02-1.05)/rotate(K.t drift)/translate back at ~0.9 alpha (so echoes propagate to edges), then draw a BOLD bright motif (large ring/ngon/cross, hue = K.t) at generous size. The scale>1 makes the tunnel expand to fill the frame. Guard wash-out with a slight multiply-darken.
style: spectral-vortex (default, hue-cycling expanding tunnel). Also: neon-kaleido (mirror the motif), infrared (thermal echoes), mono-strobe (named mono), oil-slick (iridescent).

name: Koch / Dragon Fractal
recipe: FIX of a version that was too FAINT (thin dark lines on dark, mostly empty). Re-author BOLD and BRIGHT: stroke the L-system fractal curve with a THICK glowing hue-gradient line (2-3px core + wide ADD glow), make the figure LARGE (fills ~70% of frame), and FILL the enclosed area with a faint translucent tint so it reads as a solid luminous form, not a thread. Morph between Koch snowflake / dragon / Levy families on K.t and rotate slowly. Default COLORFUL: hue-along-length spectral curve, bright, glowing on dark; luminance ~0.2-0.45, fills frame.
kernel: generate the fractal vertex list to depth D (cache per seed/depth/family); interpolate between two families by K.t; draw as a filled faint polygon (beginShape) PLUS a thick two-pass glowing hue-gradient stroke along the path; rotate + breathe on K.t. Make it big and bright.
style: spectral-curve (default, bright hue-along-length + glow on dark). Also: gold-leaf (metallic), neon (intense glow), blueprint (white on blue), ink (named mono, bold brush on cream).

name: Plasma Globe
recipe: FIX of a version whose bolts were too FAINT (read as a pink glow orb, not Tesla arcs). Re-author with DRAMATIC electricity: 8-14 vividly BRIGHT branching filaments arcing from the center electrode all the way to the sphere edge, each with a THICK white-hot core + wide colored glow (two-pass), heavy forking and jitter. Bolts re-strike to new angles frequently (on K.t/beat) with visible flicker. The central glow and outer sphere are secondary — the BOLTS must dominate and read unmistakably as lightning. Default COLORFUL: violet/cyan bolts, white-hot cores, on near-black; luminance ~0.15-0.35, bolts reach the edges.
kernel: each frame draw 8-14 branching polylines from center to the rim: recursive fork (depth 3-4) with random angle jitter reseeded per strike (re-struck on K.t/beat), each segment drawn twice — wide dim ADD glow + thin bright near-white core. Add small per-frame flicker so bolts never freeze. Soft central electrode glow + faint sphere rim.
style: violet-arc (default, violet/cyan bolts + white cores). Also: crimson-tesla (red/orange), neon-green (toxic), ice (pale blue), blueprint (named mono, white bolts on blue).
